jobs_results.title: Backend Software Engineer, DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Our DevOps team is a key part of building Avature, as they are responsible for creating the environments and tools used by our developers. As Backend Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in these tasks, while also ensuring clear communication between our IT and development areas, enabling multiple teams to collaborate toward a common goal

Your challenges and objectives:
• Provide the environments where Avature's applications run.
• Manage the deployment and configuration of those applications.
• Ensure fluent communication between the Development and IT areas.
• Envision integrations between different internal systems.
• Program complex operations to scale in distributed datacenters around the world.

Your day-to-day activities:
• Develop system tools to automate environment creation and deployments.
• Manage and design our configuration management platform.
• Interact with different virtualization platforms: AWS, KVM, LXD, Docker.
• Design and maintain our continuous... integration platform.
• Promote best practices in deployments and infrastructure management among various teams.
• Build continuous testing by automation and virtualization.
• Design and develop highly distributed systems.
• Perform code reviews, technical analysis of existing code, and refactors to improve code quality.

About you:
• Work experience in software development.
• Superior analytical/troubleshooting skills.
• Solid background in operating systems concepts.
• Fluency in any structured programming language (preferably Python).
• Knowledge (or willingness to learn) infrastructure management technologies (Puppet, Packer, Terraform, LXD, AWS, KVM, Docker, etc.)
• Experience in product as a service operation is a plus.
• Open source experience or contribution to any Linux/Unix distribution is a plus.

About Us

We’re a market leader enterprise that makes its own product: A highly flexible enterprise SaaS platform used for global talent acquisition and talent management. We currently work with over 650 companies worldwide.

Developing our own product means that we use our ideas and set our priorities, but also that when it comes to how we work, we set our own rules. We choose to work in a relaxed, energetic and creative environment, where everyone can make the most of their skills and preferences, and boost their individual capabilities through collaboration and team work.
• Due to COVID 19, all Avaturians are working from home for the moment. More information will be provided during the interview process. *

We Offer
• A fast-paced, energetic, and engaging environment.
• Flexible hours.
• Competitive salary, with one review a year.
• Four days a year to attend events related to professional development.

An organizational culture that empowers everyone to be themselves is key to thrive in business, but more importantly, it’s a pathway for creating a more equal society. Avature fosters a diverse and inclusive environment, and celebrates that each unique person brings something different to our team. We are committed to considering all qualified applicants equally and to promote equal opportunities within our organization.

Avature focuses on SaaS, CRM, and Software. Their company has offices in Argentina, Canada, China, Spain, and United States. They have a very large team that's between 1001-5000 employees.

You can view their website at http://careers.avature.net/ or find them on Twitter and LinkedIn

Then join us and use your expertise in DevOps to help our fellow human beings stay powered, informed and connected. Be part of a team that is committed to using technology as a means to bring together and enrich lives. We look forward to pursuing this forward-thinking and heart-warming mission with you! jobs_results.title: Principal Database DevOps Infrastructure Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Position

About Roche Informatics

In Roche Informatics, we build on Roche's 125-year history as one of the world's largest biotech companies, globally recognized for providing transformative innovative solutions across major disease areas. We combine human capabilities with cutting-edge technological innovations to do now what our patients need next. Our commitment to our patients' needs motivates us to deliver technology that evolves the practice of medicine.

Be part of our inclusive team at Roche Informatics, where we're driven by a shared passion for technological novelties and optimal IT solutions.

About the position

As a Principal Database Platform Engineer at Roche, you'll step into a leadership role within our global IT department, championing innovation in an environment characterized by agility, a product-centric approach, and operational efficiency. With a worldwide scope, this position places you at the forefront of shaping, evolving and optimizing our advanced... database platforms, aligning seamlessly with our commitment to efficiency and excellence.

As a specialist in this capacity, you'll spearhead the design, implementation, and optimization of our hybrid database platforms. Serving as the linchpin in our global operations, these platforms are pivotal to our product-oriented initiatives. This role is uniquely compelling as it offers the opportunity to leverage a diverse range of technologies, with a focus on automation, open source solutions, and adherence to lean principles.

You'll partner with cross-functional teams worldwide, engaging closely with Product Managers, Architects, developers, operations specialists, and senior stakeholders in providing innovative solutions to challenges associated with database platform design, evolution and optimization.

Embark on a transformative journey as a Principal Database Reliability Engineer at Roche, where innovation meets reliability. We are in search of an accomplished and visionary leader to drive the evolution of our database systems and ensure unparalleled levels of availability, scalability, and performance.

Job responsibilities
• Drive innovation and establish technical direction to the whole lifecycle of new and existing platforms and services —from inception and design through deployment, operation and retirement by applying strong software engineering principles to build and manage large scale IT infrastructure platforms and services optimizing:
• services reliability, availability, scalability and performance and eliminating work through automation
• software development and deployment by abstracting away the complexity of infrastructure providing self-service tools and APIs for developers that allow code and ship software quickly
• Responsible for continuous improvement activities both in technical, teamwork, collaboration, strategy and processes areas.
• Lead the maintenance of services once they are live by designing metrics to measure and monitor availability, latency and overall system health.
• Proactively plan for IT Infrastructure capacity, performance and scalability to support the evolution of the internal platforms and systems
• Contributes to large initiatives aimed to optimize inter-related platforms for scalability and performance, ensuring that they can handle the increasing demands of applications.
• Lead as consultant the monitoring and resolution of incident/problems with platform operations, setting priorities and ensuring all areas collaborate in the resolution when required.
• Responsible for implementation and keeping updated cost, compliance and security best practices, ensuring that platforms and services meet the corresponding requirements
• Works closely with development teams to ensure that new features and changes are rolled out with reliability in mind bringing a broader and more strategic understanding of reliability that spans multiple facets of development.
• Provide direction and guidance and set up priorities, acting as senior analyst by transforming the customer and developers needs into specific requirements to be implemented by the product team or by other teams.
• Maintain in-depth knowledge of current and emerging technologies within their technical, infrastructure area of responsibility to further the objectives of the team or department and ability to tackle complex and interdisciplinary issues.

Job Requirements
• Very strong and consistent interpersonal skills and proven strong oral and written communication skills.
• Consistently demonstrated customer & delivery focus.
• Proven strong hands-on technical skills in automation, infrastructure as code, logging, monitoring and observability, infrastructure configuration, scripting languages and applications.
• Wide experience working with Infrastructure systems internals, their availability, administration, capacity, configuration, scalability, performance and integrations.
• Wide experience applying Software Engineering principles, automated testing and CI/CD tools to:
• define technical computing infrastructure entirely under the control of software with no operator or human intervention.
• implement and maintain Internal Developers Platforms (IDPs) that enable seamless software development and deployment.
• design, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines enabling developers to easily build, test, and deploy their applications.
• Wide experience applying DepOps, design thinking and lean principles as well as prioritization and agile methodologies to evolve services offered to partners.
• Experience to continuously research, learn, innovate and share knowledge
• Strong ability to work effectively with team members and virtual teams from different locations and different cultural backgrounds.
• Demonstrated exceptional problem-solving and decision-making skills with a focus on anticipating and addressing potential challenges in database platform design and implementation.
• Demonstrated ability to function independently without supervision and navigate ambiguity.

Technology Skills
• Technical Proficiency: Exhibit mastery in Open Source solutions (ie PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS Aurora) and noSQL (ie MongoDB, GraphDB, DocumentDB, Azure CosmosDB) as well as related technologies, showcasing your ability to navigate complexities and solve intricate problems associated with database platform design.
• Proven Leadership: Showcase a distinguished career in leading database platform engineering initiatives. Demonstrate a track record of driving transformative change and setting new benchmarks for excellence.
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and/or GitOps plus required tooling (AWX, Rundeck, Ansible, Jenkins, Puppet, Chef or equivalent).
• Coding and scripting: Python, Perl, Rubby, JS, Go, SQL, GraphQL
• Mastering source code managers (Bitbucket, gitlab, github), CI/CD to automate software distribution
• Cloud native infrastructure: containerization, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Kustomize, Terraform, Pulumi, public cloud cloud-native frameworks.
• Observability, monitoring and security tools such as LogicMonitor, CloudWatch, Open Tracing, and Grafana
• Public Cloud certifications on AWS, Azure and/ or Google Cloud Platform are desired.
• Data mesh and data science experience and knowledge would be considered an asset.
• Public Cloud Solution Architect certifications on AWS, Azure and/ or Google Cloud Platform are desired.

Education / Years of experience
• 11-15 years of relevant work experience
• or 9-12 years with Bachelor’s degree
• or 6-9 years with Masters degree
• At least 8 years experience of working in one or more multinational work environments (e.g. healthcare industry experience is a plus) as a senior systems or software Engineer.

Ability to work across multiple time zones, including on-call and occasionally travel.

Who we are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Title: DevOps Engineer

Location: APAC – Remote, CANADA – Remote, EMEA – Remote, GLOBAL – Remote, LATAM – Remote, UNITED STATES – Remote

JobDescription:

Our mission is to unlock the collaborative power of communities by making Web3 universally easy to use, access, and build on.

Working with Consensys puts you at the forefront of an evolving paradigm , transforming our society for the better. We fundamentally believe blockchain is the next generation of technology that can lay the foundation for a more just and equitable society.

Blockchain tech is just over 10 years old. Ethereum itself is still a toddler and were far from reaching our full potential. Youll get to work on the tools, infrastructure, and apps that scale these platforms to billions of users.

Youll be constantly exposed to new concepts, ideas, and frameworks from your peers, and as you work on different projects challenging you to stay at the top of your game . Youll join a network of entrepreneurs and technologists... that reaches the edge of our ecosystem . Consensys alumni have moved on to become tech entrepreneurs, CEOs, and team leads at tech companies.

What youll do

We are seeking a talented DevOps Engineer capable of managing and maintaining our cloud infrastructure across Consensys. You will assist the Technology Operations team with the day to day running of a variety of platforms, assist Security teams with hardening and securing our systems and help product teams build and deploy their software.
• Configure and manage cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and GCP and Cloudflare.
• Manage and administer our CI/CD pipelines with Github.
• Maintain and improve our internal management systems .
• Respond to IT incidents and requests through Zendesk to ensure minimal downtime and loss.
• Enhance security infrastructure by using Okta for secure Identity management.
• Document all DevOps and infrastructure-related processes within Confluence.

Would be great if you brought this to the role
• Good knowledge of AWS and/or Azure cloud computing platforms.
• Experience with GitHub and understanding of version control concepts.
• Knowledge of IT ticketing systems, preferably Zendesk.
• Experience with Security and Identity management tools, preferably Okta.
• Familiarity with Confluence or equivalent documentation tools.
• Understanding of blockchain technologies and familiarity with Web3.
• Good problem-solving methods and a proactive work ethos.
• Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Strong team player with the ability to work independently when needed.
• 3+ years experience administering cloud platforms
• Certification in AWS, Azure or other Cloud platforms beneficial.

Don’t meet all the requirements? Don’t sweat it. Were passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you’ve got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environmentapply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we’re ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants will be required to submit to background checks including but not limited to employment, education and criminal record checks. Further details will be provided to applicants that successfully meet the criteria for the position as determined by the company in its sole discretion. By submitting an application for employment, you are acknowledging and consenting to this requirement.

Consensys is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is made available and accessible to everyone. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Consensys is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself which can be found ( .

The salary range for US-based candidates only will be determined throughout the interview process depending on experience and skills.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)
$135,000-$210,000 USD
